prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Algeria
Primary request: The Kasbah of Algiers, a dense historic Mediterranean hillside neighbourhood overlooking a bright blue bay.
Subject: White and cream plaster houses with flat roofs, stepped terraces, tiny shaded Ottoman-style lanes and traditional arched doorways, clustered on a real sloping coastal hill.
Scene/backdrop: Mediterranean bay and a simple distant harbour below the neighbourhood; a few green trees, blue sky. Emphasize the old urban fabric, not one giant monument.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, believable architectural geometry, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. A broad scenic view, the distinctive hillside house cluster centered and inside the central 75% of width and height, with outer breathing room for cropping.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, welcoming.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No desert dunes, European fairy castle, unrelated landmark or invented geography.
inspection: Inspected original PNG. Dense stepped white and cream hillside houses, arched old lane, Mediterranean bay and modest harbour; no Sahara dunes. Bright brush-textured children's-book style. Central old-town fabric survives crop; foreground lane extends to edges. No text/UI/flags/logos/unrelated landmark. Stylized neighbourhood rather than exact city panorama.
